title: RACE — BRIC Virtual 500m
description:
BRIC Virtual Race: 500m

Warm-up: 15 minutes of light rowing.
After 8 to 10 minutes, perform a few powerful 10-stroke bursts.
Finish the warm-up with 2 x 10 strokes at your planned 500m race pace.

Rest for 4 to 5 minutes before starting the test.

500m Test: Row 500m as fast as possible.
Start hard and accelerate quickly during the first 100m.
Settle into a strong and controlled race pace through the middle 300m.
Start increasing the effort with 100m remaining.
Give everything you have during the final 50m.
Stay powerful and maintain good technique all the way to the finish.

Record your total time, average 500m pace, average watts and stroke rate.

Cool down: 10 minutes of easy rowing.
Focus on relaxed technique and controlled breathing.

Share your results in the RowFit community.

title: RACE — BRIC Virtual 2000m
description:
BRIC Virtual Race: 2000m 

Warm-up: 15 minutes of light rowing.
After 10 minutes, perform a few intense 10-stroke bursts.
Finish the warm-up with 2 x 20 strokes at your planned race pace.

Rest for 4 minutes before starting the test.

Row 2000m as fast as possible.
Start powerfully but controlled during the first 500m.
Settle into your planned race pace between 500m and 1500m.
Increase your effort during the final 500m.
Give everything you have during the final 250m.
Maintain strong technique throughout the test.

Record your total time, average 500m pace, average watts and stroke rate.

Cool-down: 10 minutes of easy rowing.
Focus on technique and controlled breathing during the cool-down.

Share your results in the Rowfit community.
